s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive mediastinal syndrome with superior vena cava obstruction
salient_findings: Anterior mediastinal mass with multiple enlarged lymph nodes
Large pleomorphic cells with abundant cytoplasm and kidney-shaped nuclei
key_facts: 13-year-old girl
2-week history of progressive symptoms
Signs of superior vena cava syndrome
White-cell count of 6×10^9/L
Hemoglobin 85 g/L
C-reactive protein 117
Chest radiography showed anterior mediastinal mass
CT scan confirmed multiple enlarged lymph nodes
Surgical resection of mediastinal lesions yielded ten lymph nodes
Histologic sections showed effacement of nodal architecture
Immunohistochemical staining demonstrated strong CD30 positivity
Negativity for CD15, CD20, ALK, CD45Ro, and EMA

differentials: Solitary fibrous tumor of the mediastinum
per_call: Solitary fibrous tumor of the mediastinum

shortlist.label: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Strong CD30 positivity and presence of Reed–Sternberg–like cells

shortlist.label: Hodgkin lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of Reed–Sternberg–like cells and anterior mediastinal mass

shortlist.label: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Effacement of nodal architecture by cohesive sheets of large pleomorphic cells

shortlist.label: Lymphoblastic lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Age of patient and presence of mediastinal mass

shortlist.label: Mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Anterior mediastinal mass and presence of large pleomorphic cells

raw.rationale: The patient's histologic sections showed effacement of nodal architecture by cohesive sheets of large pleomorphic cells with abundant cytoplasm, kidney-shaped nuclei, and strong CD30 positivity, which are characteristic features of anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

rejected.label: Hodgkin lymphoma
rejected.why: Negativity for CD15 and CD20, and presence of kidney-shaped nuclei and strong CD30 positivity without CD15 positivity, are not typical for Hodgkin lymphoma

rejected.label: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma
rejected.why: Too broad a category, as anaplastic large cell lymphoma is a specific subtype of non-Hodgkin lymphoma

rejected.label: Lymphoblastic lymphoma
rejected.why: Lack of specific markers and morphologic features typical for lymphoblastic lymphoma, such as a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and numerous mitoses

rejected.label: Mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: Negativity for CD20 and lack of morphologic features typical for mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma, such as a diffuse large cell infiltrate with sclerosis
